dedupe_keys.name: inssept inventory of seismic structural evaluations performance functions and taxonomies for buildings

description: INSSEPT is a relational database of published performance-based earthquake engineering and probabilistic seismic demand analysis results for mid-rise buildings. It was published on DesignSafe in November 2019 by Madeleine Flint, Mohsen Zaker Esteghamati, Jeonghyun Lee, Matthew Musetich and Mahyar Sharifi Mood, and is described in a companion manuscript on an open-source relational database of seismic performance estimation for early building design. The schema is organised around building taxonomy and prioritises structural engineering use cases: comparing alternative structural systems in early design and regional portfolio risk analysis. A manual documents data provenance, use cases and sample queries, with two interactive Jupyter notebooks. Coverage: mid-rise buildings from the published literature. Access: DesignSafe Data Depot. Licence: not stated in the DataCite metadata; free. Caveats: results depend on the source studies' assumptions. Simulation uses: selecting fragility and demand models for early design and regional seismic loss models. Related records: the Colombian fragility functions and the collapse volume ratio fatality data.
